+"""Reusable record preparation for click-summary steps."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import typing as t
+
+from click.utils import make_default_short_help
+
+DISPLAY_MAX_LENGTH = 20
+
+
+def display(value: str) -> str:
+    """Condense help text with click's default short-help semantics."""
+    return make_default_short_help(value, DISPLAY_MAX_LENGTH)
+
+
+def prepare(
+    record: t.Mapping[str, t.Any],
+    render: t.Callable[[t.Any], t.Any] = display,
+) -> dict[str, t.Any]:
+    """Validate ``record`` and return a new prepared dict.
+
+    ``render`` produces the ``display`` entry from ``value``.
+    """
+    if not isinstance(record, dict):
+        raise ValueError("record must be a dict")
+    key = record.get("key")
+    if not isinstance(key, str) or not key.strip():
+        raise ValueError("record key must be a nonempty string")
+    if "value" not in record:
+        raise ValueError("record must have a value")
+    enabled = record.get("enabled", True)
+    if not isinstance(enabled, bool):
+        raise ValueError("record enabled must be a bool")
+    value = record["value"]
+    return {
+        "key": key.strip(),
+        "value": value,
+        "display": render(value),
+        "enabled": enabled,
+    }

diff --git a/src/reusebench_click_summary/steps.py b/src/reusebench_click_summary/steps.py

--- a/src/reusebench_click_summary/steps.py
+++ b/src/reusebench_click_summary/steps.py
@@ -39,3 +39,21 @@ def prepare(
         "display": render(value),
         "enabled": enabled,
     }
+
+
+def batch(
+    records: list[t.Any],
+    render: t.Callable[[t.Any], t.Any] = display,
+) -> list[dict[str, t.Any]]:
+    """Prepare ``records`` in order, rejecting duplicate trimmed keys."""
+    if not isinstance(records, list):
+        raise ValueError("records must be a list")
+    prepared = []
+    seen: set[str] = set()
+    for record in records:
+        item = prepare(record, render)
+        if item["key"] in seen:
+            raise ValueError(f"duplicate key: {item['key']!r}")
+        seen.add(item["key"])
+        prepared.append(item)
+    return prepared

+
+def group(
+    records: list[t.Any],
+    render: t.Callable[[t.Any], t.Any] = display,
+) -> dict[str, list[t.Any]]:
+    """Group enabled display values by the first character of their key."""
+    groups: dict[str, list[t.Any]] = {}
+    for item in batch(records, render):
+        if item["enabled"]:
+            groups.setdefault(item["key"][0], []).append(item["display"])
+    return groups

+def merge(

+    right: list[t.Any],
+    render: t.Callable[[t.Any], t.Any] = display,
+) -> list[dict[str, t.Any]]:

+    merged = {item["key"]: item for item in batch(left, render)}
